text:
incident-bot: ALERT: embeddings-service error-rate spike (5m avg 18%, threshold 3%)
incident-bot: severity=page, pages: @alex, @priya; link: https://internal.alerts/redwood/embeddings/1832345678
alex: oncall here — looking
priya: seeing 5xx mainly from /v1/embeddings endpoint, 503s for both hosted and a couple dedicated clusters. customers with heavy realtime use impacted.
alex: ok. first mitigation: scale embeddings-pool by +3 replicas. will also enable model-fallback to smaller quantized variant for the heavy route.
sam_k: agree on fallback. also the alert is noisy — it fires on short bursts; suggest changing the alert to 60s aggregation and require >8% for 3 consecutive windows before page.
marta: can we confirm the source? app logs show a spike in kv-cache evictions at the same time, and latency on the redis cluster jumped. could be cache pressure leading to request retries and upstream 5xx.
alex: running scale now:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy embeddings-pool --replicas=12
# rolling restart to pick new cache settings
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/embeddings-router
```
alex: scaled to 12, rolling restart started.
priya: toggling model-fallback for route /v1/embeddings -> `emb-small-q4`
```
PATCH /route-configs/embeddings
{ "fallback_model": "emb-small-q4" }
```
sam_k: I'm going to mute the alert channel for the short-term to reduce noise, but will create a non-paging alert for dashboards.
marta: customer-impact: three customers on dedicated are reporting degraded throughput, one internal demo session failed. CS notified. tagging for follow up: @jordan for customer comms.
incident-bot: note added to incident timeline.
alex: handoff in 35m — if rolling restart finishes and errors drop, we'll document threshold change. if not, escalate infra.
sam_k: created issue for alert tuning: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/issues/879 (proposed patch attached)
priya: updating runbook to include cache-pressure play and fallback entry. runbook PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/pull/412
priya: adding explicit annotation in runbook: `alerts/embeddings/error-rate` owner=platform-obs, severity=prod-page, aggregation=60s, window=3
alex: added dashboard link to thread: https://grafana.redwood/embeddings-overview?orgId=1&from=now-1h&to=now
marta: confirmed redis evictions trending back down after restart. error-rate dropping to 2.1% (5m avg). good so far.
priya: removing temporary mute in 10m and will flip paging rule to new threshold if stable. leaving a note in runbook and ops issue referencing this thread.
sam_k: small follow up: add a high-cardinality tag to alerts for `route` so we can silence dedicated customers independently. file: ops/alert-templates/embeddings.yml updated in PR 879.
jordan: taking handoff — I'll watch for customer replies and coordinate postmortem if needed. alex, if you need me to own the post-incident RCA, assign the ticket to me.
alex: thanks — assigning rca/1832345678 to @jordan.
incident-bot: incident resolved (status: degraded -> recovered). duration: ~32m. notes: scale + rollback + fallback mitigations.
priya: post-incident actions:
- merge runbook PR 412 with cache play and annotations
- merge ops issue 879 alert tuning (aggregation -> 60s, 3 windows)
- create dashboard panel for `kv_cache_evictions` with alert correlation
- run a small canary to validate fallback doesn't degrade quality

marta: +1. I'll create the dashboard PR and link it in the runbook.
sam_k: I'll follow up on silencing strategy and ensure it respects dedicated customer tags.
jordan: will draft a short customer summary for CS by EOD.
alex: handoff complete, thanks all. :thumbsup:
